name: Gold Mode
changelog: 7-Day Sign In, 999% Bonus Value and Losses pop-ups now close reliably, and unknown pop-ups are closed when the bot gets stuck. Shorter waits at startup and after pop-ups. Better screen reading on low and very high resolution phones. Clear message when a permission is switched off. New optional Gold Mode (off by default) for Ranked and Ace, Badge Hunter only with Gold Mode on: turn on auto gather and self deposit in the game first.
